reason: Evidence in the repository shows this plugin is primarily a media interaction extension for DeepSeek Harness, centered on voice I/O: microphone-based input and speech-to-text feeding the conversation composer, plus text-to-speech reply playback with interruption and announcement features, with optional external/local engines and web client settings controls.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音会话能力，让用户通过麦克风输入文本并可选择直接提交，同时可用可配置的语音引擎朗读助手回复，并支持说话时中断播放。
summaries.en: This plugin adds voice interaction to DeepSeek Harness by turning microphone input into conversation text and speaking assistant replies through configurable STT/TTS engines, with optional event announcements and playback interruption support.

capabilities: Capture microphone input for conversational transcription
Convert speech to text via configurable STT engines
Convert assistant text to speech via browser/local/remote engines
Play generated speech in browser session
Interrupt playback when user starts speaking
Announce workflow events (turn end/approval/error) via speech
Persist user-facing plugin settings through profile patch updates
Support remote endpoints or local subprocess-based voice engines

reasons.code: Plugin capability and UI surface include mic input, TTS speak tool, and speak-to-interrupt behavior, indicating media capture and playback flow.
Network and local engine usage are explicit: edge-tts and FunASR are network services, while whisper.cpp/piper are external/local binary components.
Manifest declares permissions for network outbound and subprocess spawn, confirming potential runtime security surface beyond pure UI behavior.
